URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-hands-us-revised-iranian-proposal-ending-war-2026-05-18/
TITLE: Pakistan hands US revised Iranian proposal for ending war
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-18 12:01 (updated 13:28)
AUTHORS: Ariba Shahid (Karachi), Parisa Hafezi
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY POINTS:
- Pakistan has shared with US a revised proposal from Iran to end the war
- Pakistani source: "We don't have much time"
- Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei confirmed Tehran's views "conveyed to the American side through Pakistan" but gave no details
- Pakistani source: sides "keep changing their goalposts"
- Trump (Truth Social weekend): "the Clock is Ticking. They better get moving, FAST, or there won't be anything left of them. TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE!"
- Trump expected to meet top national security advisers Tuesday to discuss options for resuming military action (per Axios)
- Trump says ceasefire is "on life support"

ISSUES STILL HOLDING UP:
- US wants Iran to dismantle nuclear program + lift Strait of Hormuz hold
- Iran wants compensation for war damage, end to US blockade of Iranian ports, halt to fighting on all fronts (incl Lebanon), guarantee against further attacks, resumption of Iranian oil sales

IRANIAN RESPONSE:
- Baghaei: Tehran "fully aware of how to respond appropriately to even the smallest mistake from the opposing side"
- Iranian armed forces spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi: US would "face new, aggressive, and surprise scenarios, and sink into a self-made quagmire"

MARKET CONTEXT:
- Global share markets slipped Monday on drone attacks
- Oil prices + bond yields higher → inflation worries
- Strait of Hormuz disruption pushed crude prices up 50%+
- Trump faces midterm elections in November
- China still hasn't committed to help resolve conflict despite Xi talks last week
